children: Cognex agreed to acquire RealSense for $500 million in an all-cash deal and will fund the purchase from existing cash and investments.
Acquisition price of $500 million (subject to customary adjustments); expected close in Q4 2026 pending closing conditions.
Deal expands Cognex into 3D robotic perception, adding exposure to a market projected to grow from $600M today to ~$1.6B by 2030.
RealSense expected to generate $80M–$90M revenue in 2026, >50% growth year-over-year.
Cognex will grant RSUs valued between $45M–$55M (grant-date price dependent) vesting over three years to retain employees.
Up to $69M in cash retention payments over three years (up to $25M subject to performance modifiers); certain key employees have acceleration protections.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Cognex to buy RealSense for $500M, funds deal from cash; up to $125M in employee retention and RSUs
